sources.title: A dynamic model to predict early occurrence of acute kidney injury in ICU hospitalized cirrhotic patients: a MIMIC database analysis

evidence.text: Multiparameter Intelligent Monitoring in Intensive Care Database IV (MIMIC-IV) is a large public relations database.
MAP, WBC, TB, GCS, Cr, Alb, HR and PLT were included in this nomogram, making it an objective and simple-to-use tool to screen patients for AKI in a dynamic online manner.
However, the number of cases in these studies was small, and a short-term prediction model for AKI in critically ill patients with cirrhosis after admission to the ICU is lacking.
However, there is no relevant research or clinical prediction model for the risk assessment of AKI within 7 days after admission in ICU patients with liver cirrhosis.
